description: Lignes de bus du réseau citibus is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Le Grand Narbonne Communauté d'Agglomération. Bus lines of the Citibus du Grand Narbonne network. These data are differentiated into 3 layers: urban lines, intercity lines and Bus Cool lines (school transport). Coverage: Le Grand Narbonne Communauté d'Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Bus lines of the citibus network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Le Grand Narbonne Communauté d'Agglomération. Its keywords include lignes-de-bus, transport, bus. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2024-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
